description:
Lists the known editions of a book in the reader's ReadingRate library (publisher, year, pages, ISBN, language and translators, cover) and says which edition the reader's current reading is in. Each reading of a book can be in its own edition: a re-read in another translation has its own pages, cover and translator, and earlier readings keep theirs.
Use when the reader says which edition, translation or printing they are reading, starts a re-read in another one, or asks which editions ReadingRate knows. Then ask them to pick one and call update_book_edition with its edition_id; if theirs is not listed, ask for the ISBN printed on the back or the copyright page (or a photo of the barcode, whose digits you read) and call update_book_edition with isbn. To start a re-read first, use update_book_status with status "reading".
Examples:
- {"book_id": "<book id>"}

book_id.description: The book's ReadingRate id or slug, or its library entry id

name: list_book_editions

current_reading.description: The reading the edition applies to: reading_id, reading_number (2 for a first re-read), status, edition_id (null when none is named)

editions.description: The known editions: edition_id, publisher, year, pages, isbn_13, format, language, translators, cover_url, current

translations.description: The book's known translations: translation_id, language, translators, original (true for the original language); pass translation_id to update_book_edition with an ISBN

title: List a book's editions
